metas.name: Find Me
metas.description: During the COVID-19 lockdown, a series of mysterious murders spreads fear across the city. As the investigation unfolds, hidden secrets and unexpected twists make it increasingly difficult to identify the killer. Every clue leads to another mystery in this Tamil crime thriller.

metas.name: Maharaja
metas.description: A barber seeks vengeance after his home is burglarized, cryptically telling police his "Lakshmi" has been taken, leaving them uncertain if it's a person or object, jeer at his request until they learn what they're really looking for.

metas.name: Photographer
metas.description: Photographer follows Veera, a troubled and obsessive photographer determined to prove his worth in a world that has long dismissed him. Driven by ambition and haunted by a painful past, he ventures deep into Mathikettan Solai, a mysterious reserve forest, to capture a rare and elusive natural phenomenon that could change his life forever.

metas.name: Parimala and Co
metas.description: A dark comedy centered around a chaotic family whose tangled relationships and unpredictable situations lead to emotionally charged and absurd moments, blending humor with underlying tension and drama.

metas.name: Jai Bhim
metas.description: A pregnant woman from a primitive tribal community, searches desperately for her husband, who is missing from police custody. So as to find her husband and seek justice for them, as their voice, a High Court advocate rises in support. Will their battle for justice succeed?

metas.name: Yavarum Nalam
metas.description: Manohar and his family move into a new apartment on the 13th floor. However, their peace is disturbed by a spirit that uses the television set as a medium to communicate with them.

metas.name: Thiraivi
metas.description: A woman is talking to a man about a plan. The man says that he needs to kill someone, but the woman says that he should not do it. The woman is shocked and does not know what to do. Then, the woman was bound and gagged by the man

metas.name: Vallavanukku Vallavan
metas.description: Ramesh accidentally gets trapped in a case of fraud when his suitcase gets swapped with another bag that contains money. Once out of prison, he sets out to prove his innocence.

metas.name: Athey Kangal
metas.description: After four brothers get killed in succession, Vimalanathan and his niece, Susila, are the sole survivors. So, Bhaskar, Susila's lover, tries to find the stalker who is hunting his lover's family.

metas.name: Vidaamuyarchi
metas.description: While struggling with his broken marriage, Arjun is pulled into a desperate search for his wife, Kayal, when she goes missing during a road trip.

metas.name: Drones
metas.description: A sleepwalking student, a mysterious miniature artist, an ancient witch, a doll house of trapped souls, and a cop cursed by love collide in a surreal world.

metas.name: Thittam Irandu
metas.description: Athira, a 25-year-old cop gets to investigate her best friend's missing case. The case turns out to be very mysterious when she suspects that her accident has been staged and that she has been murdered. After digging deep into the case, she gets to know shocking revelations about her and now she has to make some life-changing decisions.

metas.name: Dhuruvangal Pathinaaru
metas.description: A former cop looks back on the case which left him disabled and forced him to quit the force.

metas.name: Game Over
metas.description: Swapna, a nyctophobic game designer on a turbulent road to recovery from an incident that scarred her deeply, has to fight her inner demons to stay alive in the game called life.

metas.name: Iru Mugan
metas.description: A disgraced  RAW agent Akilan (Vikram) is recalled by the agency to track down a crazy scientist and a cross dresser Love (also Vikram), who has discovered a deadly new drug  ‘Speed inhaler’.

metas.name: Thadam
metas.description: The murder of a youngster creates confusion among a few cops when they find out that the one accused in the crime has a look-alike!

metas.name: Soorpanagai
metas.description: Divya, an archeologist, is tasked with helping the investigators understand the geology of the crime scene of mysterious death of a foreign national. She along with Forest Ranger Bobbili Raja unearths skeletal remains of the woman belong to a bygone era. When the forensic experts reconstruct the face from the skull, it resembles Divya and leaves all shell shocked.

metas.name: Maayon
metas.description: An archaeology team lead by Arjun Manimaran a curious and intelligent man, is on a quest to break down the myths of an ancient temple, which might put their lives at risk, whilst their work continues other conflict arises which threatens to destroy the temple's relics and antiquity.

metas.name: Black
metas.description: Vasanth and Aaranya, a couple move into a serene row house, eager for peace and privacy, but a violent storm leaves them trapped inside, unsettling supernatural disturbances threaten to unravel their marriage. Vasanth must uncover the truth behind these supernatural occurrences before everything falls apart.

metas.name: Chithha
metas.description: Easwaran, a young government employee gets the shock of his life when his niece Sundari goes missing. After initially wrongly accused of kidnapping her, he eventually comes to know that a child abuser has kidnapped her and he makes it his mission to rescue Sundari.

metas.name: Anegan
metas.description: Madhumitha is convinced that she and her colleague Ashwin were lovers in their past lives and have been brought together by fate. Is there any truth to this or is she merely hallucinating?

metas.name: Cadaver
metas.description: A pathologist and a police commissioner try to solve a series of murders involving a prisoner. Their journey leads to shocking revelations!

metas.name: Maha
metas.description: A mother who loses her child to psycho killer's killing spree goes in search for answers

metas.name: Saa Vee
metas.description: A young man's life turns into a nightmare when his uncle's dead body disappears the moment he closes his eyes.

metas.name: Fire
metas.description: A physiotherapist mysteriously disappears, triggering a police investigation. As officers question those connected to him, secrets unravel, and shocking truths come to light. Did he vanish, or was he murdered?

metas.name: UnPaarvayil
metas.description: When tragedy strikes twice, Bhavya refuses to remain a victim. Visually impaired, she is drawn into a perilous hunt for the truth behind the mysterious deaths of her husband & twin sister - uncovering a dark world where nothing is as it seems.
